Uniform hyperbolic q/Q lower bounds confine weak-reactivity minimizers to speed order a^(1/3); C2 asymptotics and the implicit function theorem yield different second coefficients c^2/8 versus c^2/5. Large-reactivity coercive localization near z=log a, derivative roots ae^-z→3/2 and →1, and strict local second derivative ensure unique extrema in that regime.
